plotPoints.premise: A group of strangers, misfits, or outcasts cross paths through chance or circumstance and begin forming deep bonds that substitute for family.
plotPoints.conflict: Their newfound unity is threatened by external forces (prejudice, enemies, survival needs) or internal clashes (mistrust, trauma, conflicting goals).

plotPoints.premise: Two characters begin in opposition due to clashing goals, rivalries, or misunderstandings.
plotPoints.conflict: Their growing attraction challenges their loyalties and threatens the paths they were committed to.

plotPoints.premise: An ordinary individual discovers they have a special destiny or power only they can fulfill.
plotPoints.conflict: They must accept responsibility while resisting manipulation from those who want to control their fate.

plotPoints.premise: A trusted ally, friend, or family member harbors hidden motives.
plotPoints.conflict: Their betrayal destabilizes the protagonist’s plans and forces painful choices about trust and loyalty.

plotPoints.premise: A hidden history, identity, or event resurfaces unexpectedly.
plotPoints.conflict: The revelation threatens relationships or disrupts the protagonist’s sense of self and safety.
plotPoints.stakes: If the truth spreads, reputations—and livelihoods—will fall.

plotPoints.premise: The characters embark on a journey to recover a powerful or legendary object.
plotPoints.conflict: Rival seekers, treacherous terrain, or the artifact’s own dangers complicate their mission.

plotPoints.premise: A prophecy foretells a hero, event, or disaster.
plotPoints.conflict: Characters wrestle with whether it is destiny, manipulation, or self-fulfilling misinterpretation.

plotPoints.premise: A morally compromised or villainous character seeks to atone for past wrongs.
plotPoints.conflict: They face mistrust, temptation, and the risk of repeating mistakes while striving to change.

plotPoints.premise: A character rises from obscurity or poverty into power, fame, or success.
plotPoints.conflict: The pressures of wealth, power, or status test their values and relationships.

plotPoints.premise: The protagonist must complete a mission or solve a problem before a deadline.
plotPoints.conflict: Unexpected obstacles, betrayals, or moral dilemmas threaten to make them too late.

plotPoints.premise: The perspective telling the story hides, distorts, or misunderstands the truth.
plotPoints.conflict: The discrepancy between perception and reality unravels into danger, mistrust, or shocking revelations.

plotPoints.premise: A protagonist faces two equally compelling but conflicting choices.
plotPoints.conflict: Whatever decision they make leads to sacrifice, regret, or unintended consequences.

plotPoints.premise: Characters begin experiencing memories that are not their own.
plotPoints.conflict: The bleed of identities threatens sanity, relationships, and the nature of self.

plotPoints.premise: Events repeat, but small details shift each time.
plotPoints.conflict: The protagonist must discover why and whether they can break free before reality collapses.

plotPoints.premise: Two previously separate realities begin to overlap.
plotPoints.conflict: Characters must navigate contradictions and threats emerging from the collision.

plotPoints.premise: A city, building, or landmass has a will of its own.
plotPoints.conflict: Its desires and actions test the survival, morality, and ingenuity of the inhabitants.

plotPoints.premise: Instead of seeking an object, power, or person, the goal seeks the protagonist.
plotPoints.conflict: The unwanted attention forces them into choices they never sought to make.

plotPoints.premise: Current events mirror forgotten or hidden histories.
plotPoints.conflict: Characters risk repeating mistakes or uncovering truths that destabilize the present.

plotPoints.premise: An otherworldly being appears with a cryptic warning or mission.
plotPoints.conflict: Its true motives are unclear, and following its message may cause more harm than good.

plotPoints.premise: A protagonist inherits responsibility, debt, or a curse from family or predecessors.
plotPoints.conflict: Carrying the burden forces them to reconcile identity, destiny, and rebellion against legacy.
